derivation: feminine active participle of H2119 (זָחַל); crawling (i.e. serpent);
def: Zocheleth, a boundary stone in. Palestine

occurrences.text: And Adonijah slew sheep and oxen and fat cattle by the stone of Zoheleth, which is by En–rogel, and called all his brethren the king’s sons, and all the men of Judah the king’s servants:
